name: Intelligence
caption: Intelligence

configuration.description: prompt = a language model answers the prompt with text (output answer). classify = TypeSafe Jev answers all questions about input in ONE request; every question has its own outputs.

Code of an AI provider profile of the AutoFlow Intelligence Setup. Empty = the default language model profile (prompt) / the first TypeSafe profile (classify). A profile of the wrong kind fails the run.
mode prompt: what the model should do. SmartText – {{…}} values of the flow are filled in before the call. Only stored for mode prompt.
mode prompt only: rows { type, reference, filename, contentBase64 } exactly like Send Email. Each resolved file is sent with the prompt: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP images and PDF, at most 20 MB together.
"Reference" (default) or "Inline", as in Send Email.
Reference rows: {{selector}} to AutoFlow Document reference(s) (table 5564415), an array or iterator of them, or name[N].
Inline rows: file name incl. extension. SmartText.
Inline rows: base64 content. SmartText. The type is read from the content's first bytes.
mode classify: the content every question is about (sent once as state.input). SmartText.
mode classify: extra named parts of the state, rows { name, value }. Questions refer to them by name in backticks, e.g. `vendor`.
Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter; not input or attachments; unique.
SmartText. Always sent as text.
mode classify: 1 to 32 rows { id, type, instructions, threshold, checkFit }.
Question name: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 18 characters, unique. It names the outputs.
choice = pick one option; score = rate on ordered levels; noul = yes/no.
The question itself. SmartText.
noul only: the output <id> is true when the probability is at least this value (0–1).
choice only: also ask whether any option applies at all (output <id>_fits). On by default – a choice always picks an option, even when none fits.
mode classify: rows { question, value, description }. choice: the options (1–255). score: the levels in order, the first row is level 0 (1–10). noul: optional descriptions with value true / false.
The id of the question the row belongs to.
Option name / level name (noul: true or false). Option names are what <id> returns.
Optional description that helps the model; an option without description is judged by its name.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.when: mode prompt: the model's text answer

outputs.name: <id>
outputs.when: mode classify, one per question: choice → the chosen option value; score → the probability-weighted level as a decimal with a point (can lie between two levels); noul → true / false at the question's threshold

outputs.name: <id>_confidence
outputs.when: choice and score questions: 0–1 with a point

outputs.name: <id>_fits
outputs.when: choice questions with checkFit: true when one of the options applies (probability ≥ 0.5)

outputs.name: <id>_level
outputs.when: score questions: the value of the most probable level row

outputs.name: <id>_probability
outputs.when: noul questions: the probability of yes, 0–1 with a point

rules.check: mode classify: input must not be empty
rules.message: Enter the input the questions are about.

rules.message: Add at least one question.

rules.check: questions[].id: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 18 characters

rules.check: questions[].type is choice, score or noul
rules.message: Question '%1': choose the type choice, score or yes/no.

rules.check: questions[].instructions not empty
rules.message: Question '%1': enter the question.

rules.check: choice: 1 to 255 options rows
rules.message: Question '%1': a choice needs 1 to %2 options.

rules.check: score: 1 to 10 level rows
rules.message: Question '%1': a score needs 1 to %2 levels.

rules.check: option values unique per question
rules.message: Question '%1': the option '%2' is listed twice.

rules.check: option value not empty
rules.message: Question '%1': an option has no value.

rules.check: noul option rows only use the values true / false
rules.message: Question '%1': a yes/no question only takes descriptions for the values true and false.

rules.check: noul threshold between 0 and 1
rules.message: Question '%1': the threshold must lie between 0 and 1.

rules.check: every options row belongs to an existing question
rules.message: The option '%1' belongs to question '%2', which does not exist.

rules.check: fields[].name: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter; not input / attachments
rules.message: Field name '%1': use letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter; 'input' and 'attachments' are taken.

rules.check: fields[].name unique
rules.message: The field name '%1' is used twice.

rules.check: mode classify takes no attachments yet
rules.message: The classify mode does not read attachments yet: images for TypeSafe follow in a later release. Only the prompt mode reads files for now.

rules.check: mode prompt needs Intelligence switched on and a language model profile (wrapped: The Intelligence step '%1': …)
rules.message: the prompt mode needs Intelligence switched on and a language model profile.

rules.check: mode classify needs Intelligence switched on and a TypeSafe profile
rules.message: the classify mode needs Intelligence switched on and a TypeSafe profile.

rules.check: the trigger runs while the user works on the record (record created/modified interactive, document released/posted/reopened, page opened/closed, PDF printed, report file name, SubFlow): the user waits for the answer
rules.message: The Intelligence step '%1' runs while the user works on the record: the user waits until the model has answered (up to the timeout of the AutoFlow Intelligence Setup).

rules.check: an attachment is no PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image or PDF
rules.message: Intelligence cannot read the attachment '%1': only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images and PDF files are supported.

rules.check: attachments together over 20 MB
rules.message: The attachments are too large for one request (%1 MB, at most %2 MB).

rules.check: the answer hit the profile's max output tokens
rules.message: The answer was cut off at %1 output tokens. Raise "Max. Output Tokens" on provider profile %2, or ask for a shorter answer.

rules.check: the model answered with no text
rules.message: The model gave an empty answer.

rules.check: profile is of the other kind
rules.message: Profile %1 is a TypeSafe classification profile; the prompt mode needs a language model profile.

notes: Prefer ONE classify step with many questions over several steps: the input is sent once, each extra question costs only its own tokens.
Act on the answers with Condition steps, e.g. {{<slug>_category}} = 'invoice' and {{<slug>_category_fits}} = 'true'. Check <id>_confidence / <id>_probability for risky actions.
Each run is logged as a session (AutoFlow Intelligence Setup → Sessions); the execution log line names the session no. A failed run fails the step.
The prompt answer is text. When later steps need structured data, ask for JSON in the prompt and read it with a Parser step.
Field values and attachments go to the provider configured in the profile.
